t2.thesis: Despite secular AI storage tailwinds, Sandisk faces classic peak-cycle semiconductor skepticism, evidenced by poor past print reactions and heavy put skew following competitor-driven pre-earnings run-ups.
reasons: SNDK has dropped at the open following 3 of its last 4 earnings reports, including a -16.1% drop in Q4 despite beating EPS by 13.7%.
Extreme cyclical profitability (gross margin expanded to 84.6% and forward P/E is 5.2x) typically causes markets to treat beats with peak-earnings skepticism.
A sympathy rally driven by SK Hynix results on the snapshot date elevates entry prices on Oct 29, raising the bar for a positive post-earnings reaction.
Options market exhibits substantial downside skew, with ATM put IV (1.22) trading significantly above call IV (1.03).
t2.deciding_variable: Whether fiscal Q2 2027 revenue and gross margin guidance can convince investors that peak NAND pricing has not been reached.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down from 0.479 to 0.45 (-0.029) due to poor historical earnings open win rate (25%), elevated peak-cycle gross margin risks, and elevated put skew ahead of the print.

theses.expected: SNDK reports a modest beat against Q1 guidance ($44-$46 EPS) but issues cautious Q2 commentary, leading to profit taking and an open below entry open.
theses.mechanism: High gross margin comparisons and fear of cyclical flash oversupply trigger 'sell-the-news' behavior.
theses.wrong_if: Datacenter revenue accelerates well beyond expectations and management provides multi-quarter supply contract commitments.

theses.expected: Pre-earnings sympathy bounce from SK Hynix inflates entry valuation, leaving minimal upside surprise buffer.
theses.mechanism: Expectations re-rate higher prior to SNDK's own print, meaning even solid numbers fail to generate next-morning follow-through.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance significantly exceeds the upper bound of analyst forecasts ($49.80 EPS).

theses.expected: High options implied volatility collapses post-announcement, with long holders de-risking at market open.
theses.mechanism: Market makers and hedgers dump long underlying delta as IV drops post-AMC announcement.
theses.wrong_if: Short squeeze dynamics take over given high institutional short positioning.

key_observations: Fiscal Q1 2027 revenue and Non-GAAP EPS vs guidance of $10.3B-$10.8B and $44-$46
Datacenter segment revenue sequential growth (Q4 was $2.98B)
Fiscal Q2 2027 gross margin and revenue guidance
Updates on New Business Model (NBM) multi-year contracted volumes
